'''Goh's Darmanitan''' (Japanese: '''ゴウのヒヒダルマ''' ''Go's Hihidaruma'') is the first {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that [[Goh]] {{pkmn2|caught}} in the [[Unova]] [[region]], and his twenty-fifth overall.

==In animation==
===History===
===={{aniseries|JN}}====
[[Goh]] first encountered Darmanitan in ''[[JN014|Raid Battle in The Ruins!]]'', when he and {{Ash}} were travelling through the [[Desert Resort]]. Darmanitan stood outside the entrance to the [[Colossus Ruins]] where it was in its {{a|Zen Mode}}. When approached, Darmanitan turned into its standard form. Goh quickly threw a {{i|Poké Ball}}, catching it and adding Darmanitan to his team.

Darmanitan was later sent out to battle a {{pkmn2|giant}} {{TP|Goh|Golurk}} that was the Guardian of the Ruins after {{TP|Goh|Scorbunny}} and {{TP|Goh|Beedrill}} were knocked out. Battling alongside [[Ash's Dragonite]], Darmanitan was able to weaken Golurk, only for the floor beneath it to collapse, forcing Goh to throw a Poké Ball and catch Golurk to save it. Darmanitan was later seen in Zen Mode at [[Cerise Laboratory]] alongside Goh's other Pokémon.
[[File:Goh Darmanitan Scorbunny.png|left|250px|thumb|Darmanitan taunting {{TP|Goh|Scorbunny}}]]
In ''[[JN017|Kicking It from Here Into Tomorrow!]]'', Darmanitan taunted Scorbunny over its lack of ability to use a {{type|Fire}} [[move]] and showed off by using its own Fire-type attack. This enraged Scorbunny to try and use {{m|Ember}}, which it was unable to do successfully, leading Darmanitan to continue to taunt it.

In ''[[JN023|Panic in the Park!]]'', during a food shortage, Darmanitan led a group of Pokémon to fight for food against another group led by [[Goh's Scyther]]. When the commotion led to [[Goh's Golurk]] going berserk and flooding the Park, Darmanitan joined the other Pokémon to save Goh's three {{p|Cascoon}}.

In ''[[JN102|Battling in the Freezing Raid!]]'', Darmanitan was the first Pokémon that Goh used in his Raid Battle against an {{p|Articuno}}, only for it to be immediately defeated by a {{m|Blizzard}} after being released from its Poké Ball.

In ''[[JN136|This Could be the Start of Something Big!]]'', Darmanitan attended a surprise party hosted by the Lab members commemorating Goh and Ash's departure.
{{-}}

===Personality and characteristics===
[[File:Goh Darmanitan and Ash Dragonite.png|250px|thumb|Darmanitan and Ash's Dragonite]]
Darmanitan is a strong Pokémon, as seen in ''[[JN014|Raid Battle in The Ruins!]]'', where it held its own against a {{pkmn2|giant}} {{TP|Goh|Golurk}} that had defeated multiple opponents.

Despite being recently {{pkmn2|caught}}, Darmanitan followed Goh's orders without any problems. It appears to respect Pokémon it perceives as strong, such as when it greeted [[Ash's Dragonite]] with a fist-bump after winning the battle against Golurk. However, it looks down on weaker Pokémon. For example, in ''[[JN017|Kicking It from Here Into Tomorrow!]]'', it taunted {{TP|Goh|Scorbunny}} over it being unable to use a {{type|Fire}} move; in ''[[JN054|Sobble Spies a Stealthy Strategy!]]'', it kept scaring {{TP|Goh|Sobble}} by popping out from the bushes. It turns into its Zen Form when it is relaxing or resting. It also has a quick temper, such as in ''[[JN023|Panic in the Park!]]'', when it attacked {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Sandile}} after it kicked it, and in ''Sobble Spies a Stealthy Strategy!'', when Sobble used {{m|Water Gun}} at it and hid. Darmanitan likes to spar with strong Pokémon, as seen in [[JN035|''Gotta Catch a'' What?!]], when it was sparring with {{TP|Goh|Heracross}}.

==Trivia==
* Darmanitan is Goh's first {{type|Psychic}} and [[Generation V]] {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}.
* Darmanitan is the first Pokémon belonging to a main character that has been confirmed to have its [[Hidden Ability]].
** It is also the only one of Goh's Pokémon to use its Ability.
* Darmanitan is the first Psychic-type Pokémon owned by one [[Ash's friends]] since [[Misty's Starmie]], who was revealed in ''[[EP007|The Water Flowers of Cerulean City]]'', 1,092 episodes earlier.
